name: hmd-ms-deployment-core
description: Registry and resolver core of the NeuronSphere deployment service: RepoClass/RepoClassVersion registration, the ResourceDefinition catalogue, resource-based dependency resolution, discovery search and RepoInstance records. The orchestrator (hmd-ms-deployment) layers on top of this image.

discovery.summary: Registry-and-resolver core of the NeuronSphere deployment service (NERD0015). Owns RepoClass/RepoClassVersion registration, the namespaced, versioned ResourceDefinition catalogue (NERD0004) with its bundled base types, Resources produced by deployments, discovery search (NERD0013) and RepoInstance records (register/status/history/config/BOM). The orchestrator, hmd-ms-deployment, builds its image FROM this one and loads this module's operations alongside its own; every /apiop/* route is unchanged. This is the image nsctl runs as the local control plane.

entry_points.description: Registered core operations -- the /apiop/* REST surface of the core image (30 endpoints).
ResourceDefinition catalogue and resource-based dependency resolution (NERD0004).
Environment graph loading and RepoInstance / RepoInstanceDeployment record management.
Dependency-ordered environment bill of materials without the DAG engine.
What the core owns and does not own.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/add_repo_class_version
capabilities.description: Registers a RepoClassVersion with its declared dependencies, default configuration and discovery metadata.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/register_deployed_instance
capabilities.description: Records a RepoInstance and its deployment with the full edge set; status DEPLOYED (default) or DEPLOY_NEXT, with optional role->instance dependencies.

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/get_deployment_config/<args_type>/<args_name>
capabilities.description: Resolved deploy configuration of an instance including its dependencies' produced resources (NERD0006).

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/get_deployment_bom/<args_type>
capabilities.description: Deployed instances of an environment in dependency order.

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/get_repo_class_instances/<args_repo_class_name>/<args_type>
capabilities.description: Pending and current deployments of a RepoClass in an environment, with deployment identifiers (alias: find_repo_class_instances).

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/seed_base_resource_definitions
capabilities.description: Idempotently seeds the bundled base ResourceDefinition catalogue (also runs at startup).

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/suggest_resource_dependencies/<args_type>
capabilities.description: RepoInstances that could satisfy a resource-typed role in an environment.

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/search_discovery
capabilities.description: Searches the discovery catalogue of registered RepoClassVersions (NERD0013).

capabilities.name: InstanceConfigResolver
capabilities.description: Builds an instance's deploy configuration from its class defaults, instance configuration and dependencies.

capabilities.name: build_environment_bom
capabilities.description: Kahn-ordered BOM over RepoInstanceReqRepoInstance edges; same node shape as the former DeployBomCreator.

capabilities.name: ResourceInformation
capabilities.description: Resource/ResourceDefinition queries, inheritance- and tag-aware satisfaction, resource submission.
